Ahmedabad University Ahmedabad
App Developer December 2024 – May 2025
– Developed a cross-platform digital marketplace to help Sristi Foundation bring small-scale organic farmers online,
enabling D2C sales, community-driven knowledge sharing, and increased awareness of organic farming practices.
– Built a Flutter-based single codebase application backed by a normalized SQL database on Supabase, implementing
farmer onboarding and document-based verification, product listing and cart workflows, community feeds with
category-based filtering, search and notifications, multilingual news translation with text-to-speech, admin dashboards for
verificationand ordermonitoring, andabehavior-based MLrecommendationsystem forpersonalizedproductdiscovery.
– Successfully onboarded 10+ verified farmers and 40+ product listings in a pilot deployment, digitized manual
onboarding and order workflows reducing verification effort by 40%.

Data Warehouse | MySQL December 2025
– Designed an end-to-end data warehouse using the Medallion (Bronze–Silver–Gold) architecture to consolidate
raw CRM and ERP data for structured analytics and reporting.
– Implemented ETL pipelines in MySQL for data ingestion, cleansing, transformation, and enrichment, modeling clean
fact and dimension tables optimized for analytical queries.
– Enabled reliable KPI dashboards, YoY analysis, and cumulative sales reporting by improving data quality,
consistency, and query performance across analytical workloads.
Wearable-Driven Exercise Recognition | Python, Jupyter Notebook December 2025
– Developed a wearable-driven barbell exercise recognition and repetition counting system using real-world
accelerometer and gyroscope (IMU) sensor data collected from gym workouts.
– Performed end-to-end signal preprocessing including resampling, noise reduction via low-pass filtering, outlier
handling

and extensive time-domain and frequency-domain feature extraction (FFT, temporal statistics),
followed by PCA-based dimensionality reduction.
– Achieved 99.25% exercise classification accuracy using a Neural Network and XGBoost, and attained 98.98%
accuracy in repetition counting through peak detection on filtered sensor signals.
Bank Management System | C Programming, System Programming, Concurrency September 2025
– Developed a multi-user Bank Management System in C using socket programming with role-based access control
(Admin, Manager, Employee, Customer).
– Implemented modular server architecture with authentication, transaction processing, loan management, and
persistent file-based storage using structured flat files.
– Designed a scalable client-server system with low-level networking, concurrent client handling, and real-world
banking workflow simulation.

Languages: C++, Python, JavaScript, SQL
Libraries & Frameworks: React.js, Tailwind CSS, Spring Boot, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Flutter
Tools & Miscellaneous: Git, GitHub, Linux, VS Code, Postman, Figma, Supabase, Google Colab
